changelog:
dingtalk-calendar-only-curl 0.1.0

- Initial release with core support for DingTalk calendar API operations using only curl.
- Provides skill routing based on user intent for scheduling, calendar events, meeting rooms, video meetings, sign-in/out, and recurrence.
- Includes configuration validation and environment variable management before API calls.
- Documents standard script templates and API reference lookup commands.
- Only unionId is supported as user identifier in API requests (not staffId).
